title: The 4 Best Portable Air Conditioners for Apartments Without Window Access
h1: The 4 Best Portable Air Conditioners for Apartments Without Window Access
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for portable air conditioners for apartments without window access, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at portable air conditioners for apartments without window access using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Whynter ARC-14S 14,000 BTU Dual Hose Portable Air Conditioner
products.blurb: Key specs: 14,000 BTU ASHRAE / 9,500 BTU SACC dual-hose cooling, Cools rooms up to 500 sq ft, Built-in dehumidifier, up to 101 pints per day.
strengths: Dual-hose design pulls air from outside instead of recirculating already-cooled room air, so it recovers temperature faster between compressor cycles
Auto drain means no manual bucket emptying under normal humidity
limitations: Needs two hose openings in the window kit, more setup than a single-hose unit
56 lbs and a larger footprint than single-hose competitors
Costs more upfront than most single-hose 14,000 BTU units
features: 14,000 BTU ASHRAE / 9,500 BTU SACC dual-hose cooling
Cools rooms up to 500 sq ft
Built-in dehumidifier, up to 101 pints per day
Auto drain with condensate self-evaporation
24-hour programmable timer, thermostat range 61°F to 89°F

products.name: BLACK+DECKER BPACT14WT Smart Portable Air Conditioner
products.blurb: Key specs: 14,000 BTU (10,200 BTU SACC) single-hose cooling, rated up to 700 sq ft, Wi-Fi app control plus Alexa and Google Assistant support, Follow Me remote reads temperature from where you're sitting.
strengths: Wi-Fi and voice control is the most complete smart home integration in this list
Follow Me remote gives a more accurate reading than the unit's built-in sensor alone
Single-hose install is faster than setting up a dual-hose kit
limitations: Manufacturer's 700 sq ft rating runs optimistic for real single-hose performance
Smart app reliability gets mixed reports on some home networks
Single-hose exhaust pulls some already-cooled room air out with it
features: 14,000 BTU (10,200 BTU SACC) single-hose cooling, rated up to 700 sq ft
Wi-Fi app control plus Alexa and Google Assistant support
Follow Me remote reads temperature from where you're sitting
24-hour programmable timer
Included window venting kit

products.name: Honeywell HL14CESWK Contempo Series Portable Air Conditioner
products.blurb: Key specs: 14,000 BTU cooling, dehumidifier and fan modes, rated up to 550-700 sq ft, Dual filtration system: washable pre-filter plus activated carbon, Dual motor design rated at 49 to 52 dB at high fan speed.
strengths: Dual filtration is more thorough than the single washable filter on most competitors
Dual motor design measurably quieter at high fan speed than single-motor units
Polished two-tone cabinet is a step up from typical plastic housings
limitations: Single-hose design, less efficient than dual-hose in very hot rooms
Fewer smart features than the BLACK+DECKER BPACT14WT
features: 14,000 BTU cooling, dehumidifier and fan modes, rated up to 550-700 sq ft
Dual filtration system: washable pre-filter plus activated carbon
Dual motor design rated at 49 to 52 dB at high fan speed

products.name: LG LP0621WSR 6,000 BTU Portable Air Conditioner
products.blurb: Key specs: 6,000 BTU DOE (8,000 BTU ASHRAE) cooling, rated up to 250 sq ft, 3-in-1 operation: cool, dehumidify, fan, Easy-roll casters and auto-swing air vent.
strengths: Smallest footprint and lightest weight in this list, easiest to move room to room
Washable filter cuts down on replacement filter costs over time
Quieter running than the larger 14,000 BTU units in this list
limitations: 250 sq ft coverage is meaningfully smaller than the 14,000 BTU models here
Single-hose design, less efficient in high-heat rooms than dual-hose units
No smart app or voice control
